'''Itamar Willner''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry|FRSC]] ({{Langx|he|איתמר וילנר}}) is an Israeli chemist who has been a professor at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] since 1986.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2008-10-11 |title=Prof. Itamar Willner |url=https://www.isracast.com/prof-itamar-willner/ |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=IsraCast |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Curriculum Vitae - Professor Itamar Willner|url=https://chem.ch.huji.ac.il/willner/|website=[[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]]|accessdate=9 January 2018}}</ref>

He completed his PhD in physical organic chemistry at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in 1978.

He was awarded the [[Israel Prize]] in Chemistry in 2002.<ref>Contributions to Science, Volume 3, Issues 1-2</ref> He has an [[h-index]] of 175 (as of 2025). Several of his papers were cited more than 1000 times.<ref>{{cite web|title=Itamar Willner|url=https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=7DZ_0BoAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=sra|website=[[Google Scholar]]|accessdate=9 January 2018}}</ref>
